content.short: DZap is a DeFi automation platform for cross-chain zaps, unified liquidity access, and one-click strategy execution.
content.description: DZap describes itself as a cross-chain DeFi automation platform built to turn complex multi-step workflows into a single transaction. Its docs highlight zapping across protocols, cross-chain migration, unified liquidity access, natural-language automation, and tooling for developers or wallets that want to embed those flows. Instead of making users bridge manually and switch between interfaces, DZap aims to package the full route into a simpler execution layer. On Mantle, it fits as automation infrastructure for users who want faster portfolio actions and for teams building smoother DeFi entry points.
